newsitem.title: USA: Pakistan to get offers for wheat tender on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to get offers for wheat tender on Tuesday.

text.p: Pakistan will receive offers for its approximate 330,000-tonne soft white wheat tender on Tuesday, according to a Pakistan embassy official and several U.S. exporters.
"We are receiving the offers tomorrow (Tuesday)," the embassy spokesman said, speaking from his Washington D.C., office.
The amount was about 330,000 tonnes, he said.
Delivery on the optional origin wheat would be for May 20-June 10, exporters and the embassy said.
Pakistan did not tender over the weekend, the embassy spokesman said. The wheat will be from United States or Australia, he added.
"It was rumored that they were going to tender over the weekend," one U.S. exporter said.
